resources.string: Add HomePod to the system media output picker.
Selected app shares the app chosen in media output. Whole device shares playback and notification sounds across apps. Microphone and call audio are excluded. Changing modes reconnects at 0% volume.

Preserve captured 44.1 kHz / 16-bit stereo without discarding samples. Uses a 150 ms reserve and 1500 ms receiver target for stable listening. Low latency uses the same audio precision. This does not turn the source into high-resolution audio.
Reserve %1$d ms · Capture %2$d ms · Receiver target %3$d ms\nChanging profiles reconnects at 0%% volume.

ON compresses audio without changing samples. OFF restores uncompressed ALAC frames. Independent of the audio profile. Data savings depend on the sound; compression may not reduce delay. Changes reconnect at 0% volume.
Fine-tune delay and buffering. Applying values switches both audio profiles off and retains the compression choice.

2 ms capture blocks and a 50 ms receiver target. Shorter targets may connect without audible playback. This is not measured end-to-end delay. Adaptive buffering starts near 8 ms; turn it off for a 0 ms reserve. Turn this mode off if dropouts increase. Applying detailed settings switches to custom settings. Changes reconnect at 0% volume.
Reserve auto 8–48 ms · Capture %1$d ms · Receiver target %2$d ms\nChanging profiles reconnects at 0%% volume.

Starts near 8 ms and increases only as needed after input shortages, up to 48 ms. Reduces again during sustained silence, trimming only excess zero samples. Audible samples are retained. Each new connection starts small. OFF uses a 0 ms reserve. Changes reconnect at 0% volume.

Smaller values can reduce delay but increase dropouts. Actual latency also depends on HomePod and the network. Targets below 50 ms are experimental and may produce no sound on HomePod even when connected. Applying settings reconnects at 0% volume.
Enable the module for System UI in Vector, then reload SystemUI.
Connect to the same Wi-Fi as your HomePod. Select it in Apple Music’s Cast chooser or the system media output picker. Each connection starts at 0% volume.
